title: Fix Session cap TOCTOU race (check-then-act across all stores)
description:
## Source
Audit swarm finding F-AG1-02 / F48 (memorysmith-agentsession-audit-26-07-18-01-55-45)

## Problem
`CreateSessionAsync` checks active count → ~50 lines of awaited work → saves. No lock, transaction, or atomic counter spans the gap. Confirmed unguarded in both `InMemoryAgentSessionStore` and `SqliteAgentSessionStore`. N simultaneous requests near cap can all pass the check and exceed the configured limit.

## Severity
Medium

## Files
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/AgentSessions/AgentSessionService.cs` lines 183-188, 239
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/AgentSessions/InMemoryAgentSessionStore.cs` lines 41-46
- `MemorySmith.Storage/SqliteAgentSessionStore.cs` lines 203-214

## Recommendation
Make capacity check atomic at the store level (conditional insert for SQLite, SemaphoreSlim per-principal for in-memory). Add concurrency test.

## Existing Coverage
No existing task.
